selective_task_undo.behavior: Compensates all retained active batches for one agent task, preserving later unrelated pixels and source settings. Returns precise affected scopes and conflicts. Conflicts reject the whole operation. A human may provide task_actor to select an agent; agents may undo only their own tasks. The compensation is one chronological undo/redo step.
selective_task_undo.limits: 40 in-memory history steps. Tasks with evicted batches are refused rather than partially undone. New/open documents reset history. No conflict override. Task-created sources with later edits and incompatible hierarchy/frame changes are protected.

image_placement: Use peerbrush_place_image for one-call placement from an absolute local PNG/JPEG path or base64 PNG. Rect is exact document-pixel destination; new_layer defaults true, layer supplies folder/sibling context, parent overrides it. new_layer:false edits existing pixels; mode over blends, replace replaces even transparent pixels. Pixels outside the rect, masks and effect stacks are preserved. Natural size at x/y is available through image.place commands. All placement is undoable.

merge_layers.single_paint: Merge down to the next sibling
merge_layers.multiple: Merge contiguous selected siblings using normal blend, in their current order
merge_layers.undo: One reversible batch; masks/effects are baked into raster pixels
merge_layers.blend: Multiple selected roots must be contiguous normal-blend siblings. Flattening a single folder preserves its external blend. Unsupported backdrop-dependent merges are rejected.

foreground_fill: paint.fill blends foreground RGBA into the current selection, or the visible canvas when unselected. Expands a raster layer to cover that area while preserving surrounding pixels, masks and effects. mask:true fills the requested/latest paint mask step in grayscale. Layer and folder locks, reservations and undo apply. A folder color target creates one ordinary child paint layer. Legacy fill source layers remain readable for PSD compatibility.
selection_geometry: selection.rect stays the axis-aligned bounding rectangle. After W/E/R selection transforms, document.selection_polygon retains the exact transformed shape. Brush, fill, shapes, gradients and copied image pixels clip to pixel centers inside this polygon. selection commands with rect reset the polygon; polygon points can also be supplied explicitly. Repeated layer transforms in one gesture use the same original selection.

painting.pressure: points:[x,y,pressure] OR aligned pressures array, 0..1; unavailable mouse force defaults to 1
painting.native_pressure: Used when the platform supplies Touch.force; taper also works with ordinary mouse input.

adjustments: One target paint layer gets a clipped adjustment; a folder gets an adjustment inside it; multiple selected roots get a scoped folder. Clip base and followers stay together; copy/delete/reorder refuse incomplete clipping units.
folder_transforms: move/transform on a folder in Color mode changes all descendants, including hidden children, around one document-space pivot. Omit pivot to use descendant bounds; selection_only:false explicitly transforms the whole folder with an active selection. Masks keep their editable native frame, group/adjustment effects sample document coordinates, and locked/reserved descendants reject the entire batch. UI selected roots exclude selected descendants and commit one gesture. Folder mask-only and selected-pixel transforms require selecting a child instead.
psd_sources: Private format 5 retains native 16-bit samples and editable PeerBrush sources; older 8-bit formats remain readable. Standard PSD raster appearance is baked for other editors. Unsupported Photoshop structure opens protected at its original precision; compatible_copy explicitly creates a flattened editable copy at the same bit depth without touching the source.

color_depth.new_document: document action new accepts bit_depth:8 or 16 (default8)
color_depth.preservation: Native samples, edits, masks, internal clipboard, effects and PSD/PNG saves retain document precision. Screen/MCP PNG previews project to 8 bits for fast observation. Importing retained native 16-bit sources promotes the document.
color_depth.limits: RGB PSD v1; unsupported profiles/Photoshop source features remain protected; full ICC management and HDR/32-bit are not implemented.

selection.empty: Active zero-coverage selection; selection=null means deselected.
selection.object_region: Deterministic perimeter-color extraction. Use peerbrush_segment for learned subject/object confidence.
selection.refinement: selection.refine and mask.refine accept smooth 0–32 px, feather 0–64 px, shift -32–32 px, contrast 0–100%, edge 0–100% and edge_radius 1–32 px. Image-guided feathering uses merged colors by default; sample_merged:false and layer select one source. Native16 mask words and original mask steps remain intact. source_revision/document_id protect snapshot-dependent results.
selection.mask_from_selection: mask.from_selection on a layer maps document coverage into its native local mask frame. mode replace/add/subtract/intersect; one undoable editable paint step.
selection.confidence_import: selection.import accepts one PNG path or base64 png, an explicit in-canvas document rect, channel luma/alpha and selection mode. Bilinear confidence resampling preserves soft edges. Maximum document/mask size 16 megapixels; original image channels stay unchanged.
selection.preview: peerbrush_observe selection_view cutout/mask/overlay returns presentation-only PNG feedback with actual document coordinates.

segmentation.provider: Optional local executable configured with PEERBRUSH_SEGMENTATION_CONFIG. Model choice, runtime and weights remain outside the application; see docs/segmentation.md.
segmentation.limits: One inference at a time, 2048-pixel preview edge, 16-megapixel document, 16 MiB JSON input/output and configurable 1–180 second timeout. Source revision/project changes cancel the result; leases and history use the shared engine.

retouch.source: Required [x,y] document coordinates; source_layer defaults to destination paint layer. source offset is relative to first destination point; frozen before destination edits. Optional sample_merged includes visible effects/masks.
retouch.guards: Optional document_id and exact source_revision reject stale or different source documents. Shared expected_revision, task reservations and locks apply.
retouch.mask: mask:true writes the active paint mask step. Source is evaluated layer mask or explicit source_step paint ID. No merged artwork into masks.
retouch.precision: Native16 source samples, premultiplied fractional interpolation and grayscale values remain native16. Heal preserves destination alpha and transparent hidden pixels.
retouch.limits: Merged sampling 16 MP; heal_radius integer 1–64 (default brush radius clamped 1–32). Brush work budgets apply.
retouch.algorithm: Clone copies sampled color/alpha through brush coverage. Heal transfers texture with local average color adaptation; not full Photoshop healing.

document_geometry.crop: Explicit exclusive rect in document pixels; shifts layer origins and retains all off-canvas pixels. Negative coordinates may expand canvas.
document_geometry.canvas: Changes canvas dimensions and anchored origins without resampling. Default center.
document_geometry.image: Resamples all layer and paint-mask sources at original depth, scales editable spatial controls, clears current/previous selections. Integer frame rounding; premultiplied bilinear with clamped edges.
document_geometry.limits: 8192 per edge, 32 MP, 128 million output samples across nonempty sources/masks. Spatial effects need proportional dimensions (integer rounding allowed); radius and source budgets apply.
document_geometry.guards: Whole-document reservation scope; locked moved/resampled layers reject. Optional document_id/source_revision; all failures atomic.
document_geometry.preview: Native Image menu shows actual shared-engine pixels and dimensions. Apply one undo; Cancel/Escape or a newer source edit discards preview.

retained_transforms.behavior: Whole-layer rotation/scaling accumulate affine placement and regenerate current raster/mask projections from retained native originals, avoiding repeated filtering across gestures. Move does not resample. Hidden folder descendants share the pivot.
retained_transforms.observation: Layer and mask step transform_source contain original width/height/bit_depth/bytes and matrix=[a,b,c,d,tx,ty] mapping original local coordinates to the current frame, or null. No tile samples in observations.
retained_transforms.pixel_edits: Painting, clone/heal, fill, direct adjustments, image replacement and selected-pixel edits establish a new baseline for only the changed raster. Other mask/color originals and effects remain editable. Image resize and explicit channel-depth conversion establish raster baselines; crop/canvas retain sources.
retained_transforms.psd: Supplementary format 9 retains originals alongside current standard raster/mask channels and merged composite. Older readers protect newer sources. Photoshop receives raster layers, not Smart Objects.
retained_transforms.limits: Current plus original tiles count against 512 MiB document memory. 8192 per edge, 32 MP, 128 million output samples per layer command; singular/nonfinite/out-of-range/nested sources refused atomically.
retained_transforms.guards: Shared engine/UI/MCP/CLI reservations, locks, document_id/source_revision and one undo per gesture. Use selection_only:false for whole-layer transforms when a selection exists.

editable_sources.observation: Each layer exposes its complete source definition or null. Preserve current width/height/matrix when editing content.
editable_sources.text: Bundled Ubuntu Sans regular/medium/semibold, explicit multiline plain text, kerning, size, line_height, left/center/right alignment, native RGBA16 color. Missing glyphs or scripts needing shaping/bidi are refused.
editable_sources.shapes: Rectangle, ellipse, or straight-segment path with editable points, even-odd fill, open/closed flag, stroke and stroke_width. Native RGBA16 fill/stroke colors.
editable_sources.coordinates: Source width/height define original local frame. x/y on add are document origins. Optional matrix=[a,b,c,d,tx,ty] maps original coordinates to current raster frame, identity by default.
editable_sources.precision: Colors are 0–65535 regardless of document depth; native16 projections preserve words and sub-byte antialias coverage. 8-bit documents project at their own boundary.
editable_sources.guards: Complete-layer transforms preserve definitions; selected-pixel/mask transforms require explicit rasterization. Color painting/placement refuses source layers. Mask painting and effects remain editable. Shared stale/revision/lock/reservation guards are atomic.
editable_sources.psd: Private source format 8 supplements current standard raster/mask channels and merged composite. Photoshop receives raster layers, not native type/vector objects. Unsupported imported Photoshop features remain protected.
editable_sources.limits: 4 MP original source frame, 4096 characters / 96 lines, size 1–1024, line_height 0.5–4, 128 path points, stroke_width 0–256, 32 million outline/path work budget.
